about: Prévost is a city in Quebec’s Laurentides, on the Rivière du Nord north of Saint-Jérôme along Autoroute 15. Wooded neighbourhoods, river valleys, and a gateway role toward the Laurentians ski and cottage country define a growing North Shore community. About 14,000 people live in Prévost.
seoSummary: Laurentides city on the Rivière du Nord north of Saint-Jérôme—wooded neighbourhoods and Laurentians gateway.
knownFor: Gateway toward Laurentians ski and cottage country
